description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, constants, and function prototypes for the Webconfig Framework API, including multi-component support, blob execution, queue management, and inter-component signaling.

classes.name: _blob_exec_state
classes.description: Enumeration representing the state of blob execution (NOT_STARTED, PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, FAILED).

classes.name: _blobRegInfo
classes.description: Structure holding subdoc name and version information for supported components.

classes.name: _Error_
classes.description: Structure for error code and message returned by blob execution handlers.

classes.name: MultiComp_ExecInfo
classes.description: Structure containing execution info for multi-component blob requests, including master/slave indicator, component name, and execution data.

classes.name: policySequence
classes.description: Structure defining execution sequence and data for multiple components in multi-component execution.

classes.name: _execData
classes.description: Main structure for blob request data, including subdoc name, transaction ID, version, user data, and function pointers for execution, rollback, and resource management.

classes.name: _queueInfo
classes.description: Internal queue structure maintaining pending blob requests with version, timeout, transaction ID, state, and data pointers.

classes.name: multiCompExecStatus
classes.description: Structure tracking execution status of individual components in multi-component execution.

classes.name: multiCompSubDocReg
classes.description: Registration structure for slave components supporting subdoc execution, including function pointers for timeout calculation, execution, rollback, and resource freeing.

methods.name: display_subDocs
methods.description: Displays supported subdocuments.

methods.name: check_component_crash
methods.description: Checks for component crash based on initialization file.

methods.name: register_sub_docs
methods.description: Registers supported subdocuments with version get/set functions.

methods.name: notifyVersion_to_Webconfig
methods.description: Notifies webconfig framework of a subdoc version update or crash.

methods.name: send_ACK
methods.description: Sends acknowledgment for a subdoc request.

methods.name: send_NACK
methods.description: Sends negative acknowledgment with error code and reason.

methods.name: execute_request
methods.description: Executes a blob request.

methods.name: messageQueueProcessing
methods.description: Processes message queue for pending requests.

methods.name: initMessageQueue
methods.description: Initializes message queue.

methods.name: checkIfVersionExecInQueue
methods.description: Checks if a version is already in execution queue.

methods.name: sendWebConfigSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal to webconfig.

methods.name: getPendingQueueTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves timeout for a pending transaction ID.

methods.name: resetSubdocVersion
methods.description: Resets the version of a subdocument.

methods.name: checkIfVersionExecInMultiCompQueue
methods.description: Checks if a version is in multi-component execution queue.

methods.name: addEntryToMultiCompQueue
methods.description: Adds an entry to the multi-component execution queue.

methods.name: removeEntryFromMultiCompQueue
methods.description: Removes an entry from the multi-component execution queue.

methods.name: isMultiCompQueueEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the multi-component queue is empty.

methods.name: isMultiCompQueueFull
methods.description: Checks if the multi-component queue is full.

methods.name: initMultiCompMaster
methods.description: Initializes multi-component master support.

methods.name: initMultiCompSlave
methods.description: Initializes multi-component slave support.

methods.name: eventRegisterSlave
methods.description: Registers slave event handler.

methods.name: eventRegisterMaster
methods.description: Registers master event handler.

methods.name: sendBlobExecutionResult
methods.description: Sends execution result of a blob to the framework.

methods.name: getMultiCompTimeOut
methods.description: Retrieves timeout for a multi-component subdoc.

methods.name: rollbackLastExec
methods.description: Triggers rollback for last execution of a subdoc.

methods.name: sendTimeoutToMaster
methods.description: Sends timeout notification to master component.

methods.name: multiCompBroadCastSignal_callbk
methods.description: Callback for multi-component broadcast signals.

methods.name: multiCompMasterProcessSignal_callbk
methods.description: Callback for master process signals.

methods.name: multiCompSlaveProcessSignal_callbk
methods.description: Callback for slave process signals.

methods.name: parseMasterData
methods.description: Parses data received from master.

methods.name: parseBroadcastData
methods.description: Parses broadcast data.

methods.name: parseSlaveData
methods.description: Parses data received from slave.
